newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's weekly forex reserves down to $1.4 bln.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's weekly forex reserves down to $1.4 bln.

text.p: Pakistan's foreign exchange reserves fell to $1.407 billion on October 24 from $1.447 billion a week earlier and $2.072 billion on October 26, 1995, the State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Tuesday.
It gave no reason for the fall in the reserves, which included $569 million within Pakistan and $149 million outside Pakistan.
But one banker said debt repayments and higher imports might have pulled the reserves down.
